en.summary: Drop discs into columns and connect four before your friends do.
en.title: Stack Four

zh-Hans.summary: 把棋子落入列中，先连成四子即可获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 四连叠

en.summary: Take one, two, or three stones. Whoever takes the final stone loses.
en.title: Last One Loses

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿走一、二或三颗石子，拿走最后一颗的人输。
zh-Hans.title: 最后一个输

en.summary: Take turns sliding numbered tiles into the empty space and restore the grid.
en.title: Pocket Slider

zh-Hans.summary: 轮流将数字滑入空格，在步数用尽前还原方阵。
zh-Hans.title: 掌上华容格

en.summary: Swap neighboring prisms, clear matching lines, and outscore your friends.
en.title: Prism Shift

zh-Hans.summary: 交换相邻棱镜，连成同色消除，在十六回合内赢得最高分。
zh-Hans.title: 棱镜交换

en.summary: Take one, two, or three tokens. The last move wins.
en.title: Take Five

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿走一、二或三个标记，拿走最后一个的人获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 拿五

en.summary: Swap adjacent tiles to trigger chain clears; every cascade feeds the next teammate.
en.title: Cascade Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 交换相邻方块触发连锁消除，每次连锁为下一位队友蓄力。
zh-Hans.title: 连锁接力

en.summary: Build four-tile blooms from the corners, balancing solo scores against rivals.
en.title: Corner Bloom

zh-Hans.summary: 从角落培育四连花簇，在单人挑战或对手竞速中争取高分。
zh-Hans.title: 角落花簇

en.summary: Make compact three-tile pulses on a narrow board where each move changes the tempo.
en.title: Quadra Pulse

zh-Hans.summary: 在窄棋盘制造紧凑三连脉冲，每一步都改变节奏。
zh-Hans.title: 四格脉冲

en.summary: Orbiting rows refill after each clear, turning every adjacent swap into a shared garden score.
en.title: Orbit Garden

zh-Hans.summary: 每次消除后环形补位，让每次相邻交换都成为共享花园得分。
zh-Hans.title: 环轨花园

en.summary: Reverse a crowded column with one-tile swaps and chase the highest alternating streak.
en.title: Switchback

zh-Hans.summary: 用一步一格的交换扭转拥挤列，追逐最高的交替连击。
zh-Hans.title: 折返连击

en.summary: Ride short horizontal tides across a wide, low board where triples are quick to spot.
en.title: Tide Three

zh-Hans.summary: 在宽而低的棋盘上追逐横向潮汐，三连目标一眼可见。
zh-Hans.title: 潮汐三连

en.summary: Drift pieces across a balanced square and turn each three-tile clear into a passing bonus.
en.title: Hexa Drift

zh-Hans.summary: 在平衡方阵中漂移棋子，把每次三连消除变成传递加分。
zh-Hans.title: 六角漂移

en.summary: Climb a tall five-column board by setting up four-tile blooms with careful hand-sized swaps.
en.title: Ladder Bloom

zh-Hans.summary: 在五列高棋盘中逐级上升，用谨慎的拇指交换布置四连花簇。
zh-Hans.title: 梯阶花簇

en.summary: Send short horizontal waves through a wide board and score before the signal fades.
en.title: Shortwave

zh-Hans.summary: 让短波穿过宽棋盘，在信号消退前完成得分。
zh-Hans.title: 短波

en.summary: March colors across a bright mosaic and hand the next player a freshly opened lane.
en.title: Mosaic March

zh-Hans.summary: 让颜色穿过明亮马赛克，为下一位玩家打开新路线。
zh-Hans.title: 马赛克行进

en.summary: Forge four-tile runs on a narrow tower where every vertical swap reshapes the next turn.
en.title: Fourfold Forge

zh-Hans.summary: 在窄塔棋盘中锻造四连，每次纵向交换都会重塑下一回合。
zh-Hans.title: 四连锻造

en.summary: Draw falling color lines across a low board and score quick triples before the rain moves on.
en.title: Rainline

zh-Hans.summary: 让下落的颜色连线穿过低矮棋盘，在雨幕移动前快速完成三连。
zh-Hans.title: 雨幕连线

en.summary: Send three-color currents down a tall board, opening a safe lane for the next player.
en.title: Triad Current

zh-Hans.summary: 让三色潮流沿高棋盘下行，为下一位玩家打开安全路线。
zh-Hans.title: 三色潮流

en.summary: Build four-color ladders through a compact prism board and protect the lead with each swap.
en.title: Prism Ladder

zh-Hans.summary: 在紧凑棱镜棋盘中搭建四连梯，用每次交换守住领先。
zh-Hans.title: 棱镜梯阵

en.summary: Chase fast three-tile comets across a wide pocket board before the turn clock burns out.
en.title: Pocket Comet

zh-Hans.summary: 在宽幅掌上棋盘追逐快速三连彗星，在回合耗尽前完成得分。
zh-Hans.title: 掌上彗星

en.summary: Cross two color currents on a square board and race to turn each opening into a scoring line.
en.title: Crosswind

zh-Hans.summary: 在方形棋盘交汇两股色流，抢先把每个缺口变成得分连线。
zh-Hans.title: 交叉风

en.summary: Set a four-tile beat on a compact board where each deliberate swap changes the rhythm.
en.title: Fourbeat

zh-Hans.summary: 在紧凑棋盘打出四连节拍，每次谨慎交换都会改变节奏。
zh-Hans.title: 四拍

en.summary: Sweep bright triples along a long low board in nine quick scoring turns.
en.title: Longlight

zh-Hans.summary: 在狭长低棋盘横扫明亮三连，用九个快速回合争夺高分。
zh-Hans.title: 长光

en.summary: Shape rare five-tile arcs on a broad board, preserving space for the next player’s long clear.
en.title: Quint Arc

zh-Hans.summary: 在宽阔棋盘塑造稀有五连弧，为下一位玩家保留长线消除空间。
zh-Hans.title: 五连弧

en.summary: Weave four-tile bands through a narrow three-color column using precise one-thumb swaps.
en.title: Pocket Weave

zh-Hans.summary: 在三色窄列中编织四连色带，用精准的单拇指交换得分。
zh-Hans.title: 掌上编织

en.summary: Find scarce triples in an eight-color mosaic and score during seven fast alternating turns.
en.title: Flash Mosaic

zh-Hans.summary: 在八色马赛克中寻找稀有三连，用七个快速交替回合争夺得分。
zh-Hans.title: 闪光马赛克

en.summary: Guide scarce three-tile currents through a tall seven-color canal over a long shared match.
en.title: Triple Canal

zh-Hans.summary: 在七色高渠中引导稀疏三连潮流，完成一场较长的共享对局。
zh-Hans.title: 三连水渠

en.summary: Stack full-width five-tile bands in a narrow pocket tower and protect each prepared column.
en.title: Fivefold Pocket

zh-Hans.summary: 在窄幅掌上高塔堆叠横贯五列的色带，守住每条已布局的列。
zh-Hans.title: 掌上五连

en.summary: Spot compact triples on a four-by-four board during six rapid turns for two or three friends.
en.title: Square Sprint

zh-Hans.summary: 在四乘四棋盘寻找紧凑三连，由两至三位朋友完成六个极速回合。
zh-Hans.title: 方格冲刺

en.summary: Two players alternate building rare five-tile beams on a balanced square board.
en.title: Dual Beam

zh-Hans.summary: 两位玩家轮流在平衡方阵中构筑稀有五连光束。
zh-Hans.title: 双人光束

en.summary: Three to six friends trade dense three-color cascades across twenty-four shared turns.
en.title: Party Cascade

zh-Hans.summary: 三至六位朋友在二十四个共享回合中轮流触发密集三色连锁。
zh-Hans.title: 派对连锁

en.summary: A two-player race to form scarce four-tile stripes across a wide seven-color field.
en.title: Twin Stripe

zh-Hans.summary: 两位玩家在七色宽幅棋盘竞逐稀有四连色带。
zh-Hans.title: 双人色带

en.summary: Four to six players compete for rare five-tile crowns in a dense three-color tower.
en.title: Five Crown

zh-Hans.summary: 四至六位玩家在密集三色高塔中争夺稀有五连王冠。
zh-Hans.title: 五连王冠

en.summary: Two players hunt scarce triples across an eight-color micro board in only five turns.
en.title: Micro Spectrum

zh-Hans.summary: 两位玩家在八色微型棋盘寻找稀有三连，仅用五回合决胜。
zh-Hans.title: 微型光谱

en.summary: Weave long four-tile bands across a large square board during a thirty-turn shared match.
en.title: Grand Weave

zh-Hans.summary: 在大型方阵中编织四连色带，完成三十回合共享长局。
zh-Hans.title: 宏幅编织

en.summary: Three to five players search an eight-color field for scarce four-tile corner lines.
en.title: Four Corners

zh-Hans.summary: 三至五位玩家在八色棋盘中寻找稀有四连角线。
zh-Hans.title: 四角连线

en.summary: Complete full-width five-tile crowns on a tiny three-color board in eight turns.
en.title: Tiny Crown

zh-Hans.summary: 在三色微型棋盘完成横贯全宽的五连王冠，共八回合。
zh-Hans.title: 微型王冠

en.summary: Five or six players steer six-color currents across a maximum-size board for forty turns.
en.title: Wide Current

zh-Hans.summary: 五至六位玩家在最大尺寸棋盘引导六色潮流，完成四十回合。
zh-Hans.title: 广域潮流

en.summary: Exactly six players trade four-tile sparks across a shallow three-color party board.
en.title: Six Seat Spark

zh-Hans.summary: 严格六位玩家在三色浅棋盘轮流制造四连火花。
zh-Hans.title: 六席火花

en.summary: Two players shape rare five-tile paths through a tall eight-color lattice.
en.title: Dual Lattice

zh-Hans.summary: 两位玩家在八色高格阵中塑造稀有五连路径。
zh-Hans.title: 双人格阵

en.summary: Three or four friends spot scarce triples on a narrow six-color board over eight turns.
en.title: Party Pebbles

zh-Hans.summary: 三至四位朋友在六色窄棋盘寻找稀有三连，共八回合。
zh-Hans.title: 派对彩石

en.summary: Exactly three players build rare five-tile crowns across a shallow five-color field.
en.title: Three Seat Crown

zh-Hans.summary: 严格三位玩家在五色浅棋盘构筑稀有五连王冠。
zh-Hans.title: 三席王冠

en.summary: Two players manage dense three-color cascades across a fifty-turn flood match.
en.title: Dual Flood

zh-Hans.summary: 两位玩家在五十回合洪流长局中管理密集三色连锁。
zh-Hans.title: 双人洪流

en.summary: Exactly four friends search an eight-color spectrum for scarce four-tile lines.
en.title: Four Seat Spectrum

zh-Hans.summary: 严格四位朋友在八色光谱中寻找稀有四连。
zh-Hans.title: 四席光谱

en.summary: Exactly five players ride quick three-tile waves across a shallow five-color board.
en.title: Five Seat Wave

zh-Hans.summary: 严格五位玩家在五色浅棋盘追逐快速三连波浪。
zh-Hans.title: 五席浪潮

en.summary: Two players race to shape five-tile crown lines across a long four-row field.
en.title: Dual Crownline

zh-Hans.summary: 两位玩家在四行长棋盘竞逐五连王冠线。
zh-Hans.title: 双人冠线

en.summary: Three to six friends build scarce four-tile lines through a tall seven-color grid.
en.title: Party Gridline

zh-Hans.summary: 三至六位朋友在七色高格阵中构筑稀有四连。
zh-Hans.title: 派对格线
